## Appearance

Charlotta is characterized by a freckled face, a snub nose, and a wide mouth that readily forms a broad smile. At various times, she has worn her hair in innumerable plaits or styled in an enormous pompadour, and she is known for wearing blue bows.

_Sources: [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P13](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0013), [v3 ch.Again P58](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0058), [v3 ch.People P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P37](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0037)_

## Personality

Charlotta is a warm-hearted handmaiden who shows genuine concern for the well-being of her beloved mistress.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)_

## History

Born with the given name Leonora, Charlotta the Fourth worked as a young handmaiden for Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). She assisted her mistress during visits from [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), and later confided her concerns to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) regarding Miss Lavendar's despondency. During [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's visit, Charlotta anxiously waited in the kitchen with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) before happily witnessing the couple's reconciliation in the garden. She continued to offer commentary as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helped plan Miss Lavendar's wedding, and she later attended Anne's own wedding at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) after eventually marrying a bricklayer named Tom.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), +31 more_

## Quotes

> “Oh, Miss Shirley, ma’am,” she breathed, “I peeked from the kitchen window . . . and he’s awful handsome . . . and just the right age for Miss Lavendar. And oh, Miss Shirley, ma’am, do you think it would be much harm to listen at the door?”
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P65](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0065)

> "But I’m sure I shan’t sleep a blessed wink, Miss Shirley, ma’am, for fear that something’ll go wrong at the last minute . . . the cream won’t whip . . . or Mr. Irving’ll have a stroke and not be able to come."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P14](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0014)

> "but there’s so much to do yet . . . and oh, Miss Shirley, ma’am, I’m skeered it’s going to rain and I wish you’d get up and tell me you think it ain’t."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P19](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0019)

> "it’s plain to be seen you and Miss Lavendar have got a secret and I think, begging your pardon if I’m too forward, Miss Shirley, ma’am, that it’s real mean not to tell me when we’ve all been such chums."
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048)

> “No, I can understand that,” said Charlotta. “A wedding ain’t poetry. Why, Miss Shirley, ma’am, you’re crying! What for?”
>
> — Charlotta — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P74](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0074)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--charlotta.md)

Charlotta and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) met when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) lost her way in the woods and arrived at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). As a welcoming host alongside her mistress, Charlotta shared tea with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and demonstrated an echoing tin horn. Their relationship developed into a friendly bond as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) frequented the lodge to visit and assist with social gatherings.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +6 more_

- Friend of — welcoming guest at Echo Lodge  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003)</sub>

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--diana-barry.md)

Charlotta first encountered [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) when [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) got lost in the woods and stumbled upon [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Charlotta served as a welcoming host alongside Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), entertaining [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) during a tea party. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) later returned to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to assist with preparations for Miss Lavendar's wedding.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +10 more_

- Friend of — welcoming guest at Echo Lodge  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003)</sub>

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--lavendar-lewis.md)

Charlotta serves as the young helper and maid to Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). She helps entertain guest visitors, prepares meals, and looks after Miss Lavendar's well-being. Deeply devoted to her employer, Charlotta worries when Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) experiences despondency and actively works with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to ensure her mistress's happiness.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +21 more_

- Serves under — employer of handmaiden  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P18](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0018), +1 more</sub>

### [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--shirley.md)

Charlotta shares a close, admiring friendship with [Shirley](../character/shirley.md), often relying on her during times of distress. When concerned about Miss Lavendar's apathy, Charlotta confides her worries to [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) to seek her assistance. The two also team up to gather strawberries, prepare for [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's visit, and assist with Miss Lavendar's wedding arrangements.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P1](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0001), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P31](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0031), +34 more_

- Friend of — admires her and confides in her  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v3 ch.Revelation P0](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0000)</sub>
